notes: Event date: 5 May 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 19 p. 469-471: a 300-man German detachment held the Fern Pass against the 44th Division from 1 May; on the 5th, in midmorning, the German commander suggested a truce pending the outcome of the Nineteenth Army's negotiations, General Dean agreed on condition of the evacuation of Landeck, and "a battalion of the 44th Division occupied the town that afternoon").
